rules.accepted_credit_types: Category I: courses, workshops, seminars, symposia, postdoctoral institutes by Board-approved sponsors; home study by approved organizations max 10 h. Category II (max 20): journal clubs, colloquia, case conferences, programs at professional meetings. Unapproved courses may be submitted for Board approval.
rules.new_licensee_rule: HSPP endorsement issued in the first year of the biennium: 20 h (min 10 Category I); issued in the second year: exempt for the first renewal.
rules.audit_note: Keep verification of Category I and records of Category II for 5 years; send only if the Board requests.
rules.notes: Only psychologists endorsed as health service providers in psychology (HSPP) need CE; non-HSPP psychologists need none. Ethics: 6 h, at least 3 in Category I. Licenses expire Sept 1 of even years (valid through Aug 31).
